name: Qwen Sparse Attention · QSA
tagline: Compress micro-blocks before selecting historical context.
description: Four-token key blocks are pooled for indexer scoring. Attention selects fully visible historical blocks and retains the unfinished tail. Only the QSA mixer is transferred, without the original system’s hybrid layers or additional training recipe.
mechanism: Four-token key pooling, followed by RMSNorm and partial RoPE
Up to 64 complete blocks within a 256-token selection budget
Cross-head normalized, max-pooled teacher targets with KL supervision on selected blocks
limitations: Excludes the GDN/QSA hybrid, MoE, gated residuals, MTP and 256K continued pretraining. The tail can add up to 3 tokens.
